title: Delhi Police proposes new Ramlila ground protest rules, sets 50,000-person limit

ai.summary: Delhi Police proposed new protest rules for Ramlila Ground with a 50,000-person limit, fixed timings and security measures after removing Jantar Mantar as a protest venue.

facts.claim: Delhi Police has proposed new Ramlila Ground protest guidelines, including a 50,000-person limit, fixed timings and stricter security measures
facts.quote: Delhi Police has proposed new Ramlila Ground protest guidelines, including a 50,000-person limit, fixed timings and stricter security measures.

facts.claim: The move comes after Delhi Police issued a standing order on October 11, removing Jantar Mantar from the list of designated protest venues
facts.quote: The move comes after Delhi Police issued a standing order on October 11, removing Jantar Mantar from the list of designated protest venues.

facts.claim: Ramlila Ground, Burari Ground and CBD Ground in east Delhi were identified as alternative locations for demonstrations
facts.quote: Ramlila Ground, Burari Ground and CBD Ground in east Delhi were identified as alternative locations for demonstrations.

facts.claim: Under the proposed SOP, organisers will first need to obtain confirmation from the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) regarding the availability of Ramlila Ground
facts.quote: Under the proposed SOP, organisers will first need to obtain confirmation from the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) regarding the availability of Ramlila Ground.

facts.claim: Applications will generally have to be submitted at least 10 days before the scheduled event
facts.quote: Applications will generally have to be submitted at least 10 days before the scheduled event.

facts.claim: The proposed guidelines also include restrictions on items that could pose security risks
facts.quote: The proposed guidelines also include restrictions on items that could pose security risks.

facts.claim: Ramlila Ground has recently hosted several major political events, including the INDIA bloc’s November 1 rally against alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls
facts.quote: Ramlila Ground has recently hosted several major political events, including the INDIA bloc’s November 1 rally against alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

ai.background_note: Delhi Police removed Jantar Mantar as a protest venue and designated Ramlila Ground as an alternative after a committee recommended new protest locations.
